international.notes: UDA’s Unidad de Relaciones Internacionales manages agreements and mobility for students, academics and staff. Its mobility regulation states that curricular plans and programmes are taught only in Spanish.

profile_paragraphs: UDA’s Faculty of Medicine was inaugurated in August 2018 in Copiapó. Its Medicine degree was created in 2017 and first taught in 2018; UDA describes it as the only medical degree offer in the Atacama Region.
The programme received four years of CNA accreditation in August 2026. UDA states that it has two graduating cohorts, so this is still a young faculty rather than an established large medical school.

Clinical training is linked to the Hospital Regional de Copiapó and Hospital Provincial del Huasco in Vallenar, with regional rotations. UDA also identified Clínica Atacama and CESFAM Pedro León Gallo as associated clinical fields.

For a rheumatologist, the affiliated Hospital Regional de Copiapó has a documented rheumatology/immunology service. UDA has not published evidence of its own rheumatology specialty programme, and its medical teaching is in Spanish.

The live UDA vacancies page had three open academic-research posts, all outside Medicine. Its international office supports academic mobility and agreements, but a foreign clinician would need to clarify Chilean professional-recognition and immigration requirements separately.
